title: 精神航空停运：乘客退款或延迟，额外补偿无望，谁为滞留买单？
speaker: George Ferguson

segments.en: I think you'll be lucky to get your refund in any kind of short order.
segments.zh: 能很快拿到退款就算幸运了。

segments.en: And yes, I think everything else, you're never going to see any reimbursement for the inconvenience that occurred to you.
segments.zh: 至于其他，因不便产生的费用恐怕无法获得补偿。

segments.en: It is probably good to know that we looked last night at what spirit had on the schedule for 2Q and 3Q, which is usually used, but about as far as airline schedule. They're less than 2% of the US and Caribbean marketplace, so it's not going to be.
segments.zh: 我们昨晚查看了精神航空二三季度的航班计划，其在美国和加勒比市场份额不足2%，影响有限。

segments.en: It's a big effect that happened to you, not going to be a huge effect in the market. I'm going to assume Carolyn didn't use her debit card, so maybe the credit card company will step in here.
segments.zh: 对个人影响大，但对市场影响不大。假设卡罗琳没用借记卡，信用卡公司或许能介入。
